paper_id: Recursive Self-Improvement of Predicates for Skill Routing via Minimum Bayes Risk Replay and Held-out Gates
review_type: Independent narrative, claims, related-work and main/appendix self-containment subreview

scope.source_of_truth: Frozen current source snapshot, corroborated against current PDF text; historical run bindings unconfirmed.
scope.policy_audit: Out of delegated scope. Supplied guides read; exact venue/cycle/stage and submission permissions unverified. No confirmed compliance blocker asserted.
limitations: Not an independent recalculation of all reported numbers or historical experiment audit.
Related-work verification is restricted to available saved primary-source evidence, not a broad literature survey.
scope.historical_binding_score_policy: ISSUE-005 is a conditional evidence request, excluded as a confirmed manuscript defect from the scores.

headline_verdict: The central language-agent routing contribution is clear and substantially more self-contained after the replay, ranking, split and frozen-baseline corrections. The strongest confirmed narrative overclaim remains the supposed model-capability ceiling. Single-evaluation superiority and cost claims need local scope qualifiers, and the common-initialization claim needs immutable historical confirmation before being treated as a proven design defect. Internal overall judgment is borderline, not an official ARR rating.

contribution.justification: Useful concrete combination of editable per-skill predicates, bounded empirical replay selection and cold-start validation admission, evaluated across six NLP-agent task settings. Novelty is this representation/update combination, not generic reflective optimization or a new Bayesian guarantee; close JTPRO work is acknowledged.

presentation.justification: Thesis, contributions and principal outcomes are recoverable, and important previous contradictions are fixed. Remaining gate/metric/statistical/cost qualifications require appendix consultation; unsupported ceiling language and visible copyediting defects prevent a strong score.

overall.justification: Borderline internal judgment from the manuscript alone: concrete routing improvements and candid downstream/benchmark exceptions support a substantive contribution, but the unsupported ceiling and missing primary-comparison precision prevent a strong score. The conditional historical-initialization question is not used as a confirmed flaw or an additional score penalty. Most narrative repairs need text or saved-output analysis rather than new sweeps.

narrative_diagnostics.recoverable_thesis: Explicit per-skill applicability predicates can be refined from labeled routing failures using bounded replay selection and a cold-start validation gate, improving held-out-task routing without changing model weights.
narrative_diagnostics.front_page: The title/abstract identify replay and validation; Figure 1 caption supplies a concrete applicability-versus-topical-relatedness example. Figure 2 carries the update overview. Requiring Figure 1 to depict the whole algorithm would be optional editorial advice.

contribution_ladder.claimed_contribution: We propose RouterBSI, a non-parametric skill-routing framework that evaluates explicit applicability predicates over retrieved candidates, making routing criteria interpretable and directly editable without updating the underlying language model.
contribution_ladder.assessment: Editable and inspectable are representation properties; no human-edit performance study is claimed or required for that narrow statement.

contribution_ladder.claimed_contribution: We develop a recursive self-improvement procedure that refines predicates from routing failures, selects updates through minimum Bayes risk over a bounded replay of relevant and irrelevant tasks, and rejects updates with higher held-out validation error than the cold-start predicate.
contribution_ladder.assessment: Core mechanism is delivered; residual execution summary is ISSUE-002. No universal test or monotonic-across-iteration guarantee should be inferred.

contribution_ladder.claimed_contribution: We evaluate RouterBSI on six SRA-Bench datasets with a shared 26K-skill corpus, achieving the highest aggregate nDCG@10 and Hit@1 among evaluated methods while ablations establish the contributions of replay and validation.
contribution_ladder.assessment: Reported aggregate routing leadership is delivered, not universal per-dataset or downstream leadership. Ablation establishment is conditional on ISSUE-005; Hit@1 is nDCG@1 under these labels.

evidence_checked.paper: SkillRouter: Skill Routing for LLM Agents at Scale
evidence_checked.observed: Saved abstract describes a body-aware retrieve-and-rerank pipeline. Its full-pipeline parameter total does not contradict the manuscript naming the reranker component size, and it cannot certify which historical checkpoint was run.

related_work_assessment.novelty_boundary: Specific per-skill natural-language predicate state, per-label bounded replay scoring and strict validation admission relative to cold-start. Reflective editing and validation selection are not themselves newly invented here.
related_work_assessment.optional_positioning: A short reflective-optimization connection could sharpen positioning; no new citation or forced MBR rename is needed to understand the explicit empirical-risk equation. Any generic claim that every parametric system requires large data should be kept modest, not treated as a proved taxonomy theorem.
related_work_assessment.not_claimed: No full verification of every bibliography item or all taxonomy assignments; no broad literature-completeness verdict.
